trackingScale.note: Gian chu la HAM CUA CO CHU (apple-design 15). Chu noi dung 14.5px dung o 0 va la goc thang. Khong viet so truc tiep vao letter-spacing.

radiusScale.note: Ba bac, cong 999px CHI cho pill trang thai va 50% cho hinh tron. Khong viet so truc tiep vao border-radius.
radiusScale.rule: Ban kinh trong = ban kinh ngoai - dem.

accessibility.prefers-reduced-motion: It hon va diu hon, KHONG phai bang khong: giu mo dan va doi mau, bo tinh tien / phong to / do tre theo tang, cat han hieu ung lap vo han.
accessibility.prefers-reduced-transparency: Thanh tieu de thanh nen duc + vien 1px; bo backdrop-filter va bo mep cuon.
accessibility.prefers-contrast: Dam hoa ink-muted / ink-faint / line; vong focus day 3px; vien muc cho nut phu va o nhap.
accessibility.warning: Dung them lai quy tac `*{animation-duration:.01ms!important}` — vi !important tren `*`, no de len chinh khoi giam-chuyen-dong co can nhac.

layout.frame: height:100dvh; overflow:hidden — khung co dinh, khong phai trang tai lieu dai.
layout.scroller: Vung cuon DUY NHAT la `.app-main`. Thanh ben va thanh tieu de dung yen.
layout.evidence: Do tren bang 25 dong: truoc khi sua, cuon xuong day thi topbar o -1516px va 0/10 muc dieu huong con nhin thay.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Hành động chính — viên nang ĐẶC màu chàm. Chỉ một cái trên mỗi màn hình.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 22px; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.30) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 46%, transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, #7075f5 0%, #5b5fe3 52%, #4f46e5 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.46), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(49,46,129,.30), 0 1px 2px rgba(79,70,229,.22), 0 14px 28px -10px rgba(79,70,229,.46), 0 5px 12px -4px rgba(79,70,229,.30); transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.12,.52,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; padding: 1px; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,255,255,.70) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.14) 42%, rgba(255,255,255,.05) 60%, rgba(255,255,255,.38) 100%); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); mask-composite: exclude; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.34) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.08) 46%, transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, #7a7ff7 0%, #6367e8 52%, #5850ea 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.50), 0 1px 2px rgba(79,70,229,.22), 0 20px 38px -10px rgba(79,70,229,.52), 0 7px 16px -4px rgba(79,70,229,.34); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99,102,241,.40), 0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,.07), 0 18px 38px -14px rgba(16,24,40,.30); }

components.name: Secondary Button (glass)
components.description: Hình thái mặc định của mọi nút không phải hành động chính — kính trong thật sự, mép vát bắt sáng.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 22px; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; color: #17203a; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.10) 38%, transparent 62%), rgba(255,255,255,.72); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06), 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(16,24,40,.22), 0 2px 5px -2px rgba(16,24,40,.10); transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.12,.52,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; padding: 1px; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.42) 20%, rgba(255,255,255,.05) 46%, rgba(255,255,255,.34) 74%, rgba(255,255,255,.92) 100%); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); mask-composite: exclude; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.10) 38%, transparent 62%), rgba(255,255,255,.86); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,.07), 0 18px 38px -14px rgba(16,24,40,.30), 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(16,24,40,.16); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(.96); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99,102,241,.40), 0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,.07), 0 18px 38px -14px rgba(16,24,40,.30); }

components.name: Glass Search Input
components.description: Ô tìm kiếm/lọc trên thanh công cụ — viên nang kính h=40px. Placeholder #4b5566 để giữ 4.5:1 trên nền trong suốt.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; max-width: 440px; } .ds-search__icon { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 18px; height: 18px; color: #7c8a9c; display: flex; } .ds-search__icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-search__input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 36px 0 38px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #17203a; outline: none; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.10) 38%, transparent 62%), rgba(255,255,255,.72); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.07), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.75), 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06), 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(16,24,40,.22); transition: box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-search__input::placeholder { color: #4b5566; } .ds-search__input:focus { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.10) 38%, transparent 62%), rgba(255,255,255,.92); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.05), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.9), 0 0 0 3px rgba(99,102,241,.32), 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06), 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(16,24,40,.22); }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Ô nhập trong form/modal — viên nang h=44px trên nền trắng. CỐ Ý không dùng backdrop-filter: chữ đang gõ cần rõ tuyệt đối.
components.css: .ds-form-label { display: block; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #334155; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-req { color: #dc2626; } .ds-form-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,.10); border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #0f172a; outline: none; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,1) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.4) 50%, transparent 55%), #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8); transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-form-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-form-input:focus { border-color: #6366f1; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 0 0 3px rgba(99,102,241,0.14); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Hàng điều hướng = viên nang. Mục đang chọn là viên nang ĐẶC chàm nổi trên kính — nền xám nhạt sẽ tàng hình trên kính trong.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 240px; padding: 10px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.46) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.28) 100%); border-radius: 20px; } .ds-nav__item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #435061; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.12,.52,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav__icon { display: inline-flex; flex-shrink: 0; opacity: .72; } .ds-nav__icon svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; } .ds-nav__item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.62); color: #0f172a; } .ds-nav__item:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-nav__item--active { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #7075f5 0%, #5b5fe3 52%, #4f46e5 100%); color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.42), 0 1px 2px rgba(79,70,229,.20), 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(79,70,229,.44), 0 3px 7px -2px rgba(79,70,229,.28); } .ds-nav__item--active .ds-nav__icon { opacity: 1; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Máng kính lõm; mục chưa chọn là chữ trần, mục đang chọn là viên nang trắng nổi lên.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; gap: 2px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16,24,40,.07) 0%, rgba(16,24,40,.03) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.10), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.60); } .ds-segmented__tab { border: none; background: transparent; padding: 7px 15px; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #55617a; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.12,.52,1); } .ds-segmented__tab:hover { color: #17203a; } .ds-segmented__tab:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-segmented__tab--active { color: #17203a; font-weight: 700; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.88) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,1), 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.10), 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(16,24,40,.24); } .ds-segmented__tab--active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stat Card (opaque content layer)
components.description: Tấm ĐỤC r=20. Không bao giờ có backdrop-filter. Bán kính đồng tâm: 20 − 18 đệm = 12 cho ô icon.
components.html: Tổng tài khoản1.284
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 20px; padding: 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(16,24,40,.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.05), 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(16,24,40,.18); transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.12,.52,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-stat-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(16,24,40,.08), 0 2px 4px rgba(16,24,40,.06), 0 18px 36px -16px rgba(16,24,40,.26); } .ds-stat-card__icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-stat-card__icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-stat-card__icon--blue { background: #eff6ff; color: #2563eb; } .ds-stat-card__label { font-size: 14px; color: #64748b; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-stat-card__value { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a; line-height: 1.25; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Trạng thái mã hoá bằng HÌNH (chấm currentColor) + màu ngữ nghĩa, không chỉ bằng màu.
components.html: Đang hoạt động Đã khoá
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-pill__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status-pill--active { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; } .ds-status-pill--locked { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; } .ds-status-pill--inactive { background: #f1f5f9; color: #64748b; }

components.name: Glass Popover (morph-open)
components.description: Khoảnh khắc chuyển động chữ ký của hệ: kính NỞ RA từ góc nút bấm, độ đặc dâng lên trong lúc nở — không trượt vào từ ngoài.
components.css: .ds-popover-wrap { position: relative; height: 170px; } .ds-popover { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; min-width: 216px; padding: 6px; border: none; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.10) 38%, transparent 62%), rgba(255,255,255,.88); backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,.07), 0 18px 38px -14px rgba(16,24,40,.30), 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(16,24,40,.16); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; transform-origin: top right; animation: ds-popover-in 300ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.12,.52,1) both; } @keyframes ds-popover-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px) scale(.88); backdrop-filter: blur(0) saturate(100%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(0) saturate(100%); } 60% { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%); } } .ds-popover__item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #334155; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-popover__item:hover { background: #f1f5f9; } .ds-popover__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-popover__item--danger { color: #dc2626; } .ds-popover__item--danger:hover { background: #fef2f2; }

components.name: Glass Window Shell
components.description: Tấm kính DUY NHẤT blur môi trường. Vòng khúc xạ rìa 1px bằng mask-composite, lõi cắt rỗng nên không đè nội dung.
components.html: Tầng nội dung đục nằm bên trong
components.css: .ds-env { padding: 24px; border-radius: 24px; background: radial-gradient(50% 42% at 8% 4%, rgba(255,214,150,.95) 0%, rgba(255,199,126,.50) 40%, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(40% 36% at 88% 52%, rgba(186,212,248,.66) 0%, transparent 76%), linear-gradient(158deg, #f3e7d6 0%, #ded6cd 34%, #c2c5cf 68%, #9ea5b4 100%); } .ds-window { position: relative; border-radius: 30px; border: none; padding: 22px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.10) 38%, transparent 62%), rgba(255,255,255,.60); backdrop-filter: blur(44px) saturate(185%) brightness(1.06); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(44px) saturate(185%) brightness(1.06); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(16,24,40,.08), 0 44px 92px -32px rgba(16,24,40,.44), 0 16px 34px -18px rgba(16,24,40,.22); } .ds-window::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; padding: 1px; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.42) 20%, rgba(255,255,255,.05) 46%, rgba(255,255,255,.34) 74%, rgba(255,255,255,.92) 100%); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); mask-composite: exclude; } .ds-window__body { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px; padding: 18px; font-family: 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #334155; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(16,24,40,.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.05), 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(16,24,40,.18); }

narrative: Toi gian bien tap: don sac am, cau truc do duong ke 1px dam nhiem thay cho bong do, tuong phan den tu co chu va do dam thay vi khoi mau. Mau la tai nguyen khan hiem, chi dung cho ngu nghia qua 4 cap pastel da khu bao hoa. Khong gradient, khong kinh mo, khong nut vien nang, khong mau thuong hieu. Thay the hoan toan he Liquid Glass truoc do.
